decisions.reason: Removal of the remote and hybrid leadership chapter does not necessarily change the topic, format, or question-count policy of this separate chapter.
This is an independent chapter, and removal of the remote and hybrid leadership chapter does not entail any change to its content or format.
The layered-answer rules remain applicable to other interview questions and contain no remote-chapter-specific attribute requiring removal.
Removing one chapter does not change the established 50,000-word cap or the confirmed 13,000-word revisions-and-additions budget; no replacement allocation is stated.
The pre-project test was already completed and accepted, so the later chapter removal does not alter its historical deliverables or outcome.
Removal of the chapter does not establish a replacement delivery date, duration, milestone order, or other timeline value suitable for a propagated MODIFY.
